subject: general
question: Ustad Amjad Ali Khan plays which of the following instruments?
solution:
Correct answer is __**Sarod.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ustad Amjad Ali Khan **is an** Indian classical sarod player**, best famous for his clear and fast **ekhara taans**.
 
• He was** born into a classical musical family** and has performed internationally since the** 1960s.**
 
• Sarod, **stringed musical instrument of the lute family** that is normally to the Hindustani music tradition of northern India.
 
• The modern classical sarod is about** 100 cm (39 inches)** long and has a slightly waisted wood body with a skin belly.
 
• [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/bab5e6b5957830bd74320197830d6d0f49348e752bf13117ca7aa433b2eee467.png] 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Santoor, also called santouri, **stringed instrument of the hammered dulcimer, or struck zither.**
 
• ​Shehnai, **double-reed conical oboe of North India.** 
 
• **A flute** is a musical wind instrument consisting of a long tube with holes in it.
